name: The Withered King
story: A voice reaches Arith in the Void. Beyond it, a ruined palace.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith wakes in the Void. A voice leads him to a ruined palace.

beforeStory.speaker: Withered King
beforeStory.text: One last duel. Will you stay?

beforeStory.speaker: Withered King
beforeStory.text: Choose a number, then another. Add them. Stay until it is over.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The King turns his attacks toward himself. At last, he returns to the Void. Arith stands before the empty throne.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Outside, Mara Venn sleeps on a white bench. Arith wakes her.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: Have we arrived? ... I do not know why I was here. I remember I have somewhere to go.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: Will you walk with me? ... Sit for a moment first. I am not quite awake.
